limitations: V8 ranges are remapped through compiler source maps; this is not source-instrumented Istanbul statement or branch measurement.

Istanbul function metrics describe mapped V8 function ranges. The separate source-function inventory matches declaration/header and end locations conservatively; unmapped functions are not claimed executed or unexecuted.

Type-only, blank and compiler-eliminated lines may be represented differently by V8 line conversion. Server components without browser maps are listed separately and excluded from measured denominators.
Only successful test captures whose bundle and original source checksums match this build are merged; this run may be a subset of the full browser suite.
No 100 percent coverage or correctness claim is implied; inspect uncovered lines/functions and unavailable files.
